definition: Per-route Bench2Drive results for the native-rate campaign (18-20 Sep 2026, RunPod RTX PRO 6000, CARLA 0.9.15 Epic), one record per route per model. Each record is the attempt the ingest scored -- the latest source run id whose results.json parses as a measurement -- so these records and the tracked results/bench2drive/<model>/<run_id> aggregates come from the same files. `scores` are the evaluator's own; `infractions` are recorded counts, not rates. `min_speed_infractions` is a per-checkpoint speed-ratio log, not a violation (see bench2drive-speed-normalization.md), so it is excluded from any total. The 20 Hz side of every published comparison comes from bench2drive-speed-normalization.json, restricted to the routes scored at both rates. Routes listed in `unscorable` were requested and never scored; they are absent from `records` and are n_failed in the tracked run.json, never a zero.

alpamayo15.3800: CARLA segfaults (Signal=11) at ~1300-1411 frames; no attempt wrote a scoring checkpoint, so no results.json reached the tree

qwendrive.3800: CARLA segfaults (Signal=11) at ~1300-1411 frames; the one attempt that wrote a results.json has no records in _checkpoint
